verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a processor (silicon hardware), not a software product with its own user-facing data or UI, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers only acceleration of AI workloads run by other software (Apple Intelligence, Core ML, Foundation Models, third-party apps such as LM Studio). That is host-platform and app-level capability, not the chip itself shipping an insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
